verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes its own REST API reference, auto-generated from a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.1 V1 spec in JSON and YAML, so a first-party API reference clearly exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that the reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the standard well-known paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser explorer, runnable/try-it request examples, code samples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Fivetran publishes a dedicated "OpenAPI Definition (V1)" page with direct JSON and YAML downloads of the full REST API specification, from which the API reference is auto-generated.
